## Model Details

This model is an MXFP4 (mixed MXFP4 experts / MXFP8 linear) model of [deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731) generated by [intel/auto-round](https://github.com/intel/auto-round) using RTN. Please follow the license of the original model.

- **Quantized (MXFP4)**: routed experts
- **Kept in BF16**: router / embeddings / lm_head

## How to Use

### Environment

```bash
pip install vllm==0.29.0
uv pip install git+https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm.git@1b6e277ac010fb3361369162c42d39b06d612e24
```

### vLLM Usage

```bash
vllm serve intel-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-MXFP4-Mixed-CT-AutoRound
```

## Evaluation

| Benchmark | BF16 | MXFP4 | Recovery |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| GSM8K | 95.83 | 95.68 | 99.84% |
| MMLU | 86.49 | 86.31 | 99.79% |
| PIQA | 83.41 | 82.32 | 98.69% |
| HellaSwag | 68.18 | 67.88 | 99.56% |
| **Average** | **83.48** | **83.05** | **99.48%** |

## Generate the Model

The original AutoRound version and source revision were not recorded for this checkpoint. The DeepSeek-V4 Flash/Pro generation PR is not evidence of this checkpoint's toolchain; obtain its exact build from the model maintainer for end-to-end regeneration.

```bash
auto-round \
    --model_name deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 \
    --model_free \
    --scheme MXFP8 \
    --ignore_layers "compressor,indexer.weights_proj" \
    --layer_config "{ffn.experts:{bits:4,data_type:mx_fp}}" \
    --format llm_compressor \
    --output_dir DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-MXFP4-Mixed-CT-AutoRound
```

## Ethical Considerations and Limitations

The model can produce factually incorrect output, and should not be relied on to produce factually accurate information. Because of the limitations of the pretrained model and the finetuning datasets, it is possible that this model could generate lewd, biased or otherwise offensive outputs.
Therefore, before deploying any applications of the model, developers should perform safety testing.

## Caveats and Recommendations

The vLLM PR pinned above supports a BF16 fallback for the compressed-tensors output projection. The reported evaluation instead used an MXFP8 GEMM path whose exact build was not recorded; this installation must not be treated as that original evaluation environment.

Users (both direct and downstream) should be made aware of the risks, biases and limitations of the model.
Here are a couple of useful links to learn more about Intel's AI software:

- [Intel Neural Compressor](https://github.com/intel/neural-compressor)
- [AutoRound](https://github.com/intel/auto-round)
